notes: The `ConfigServer` initializer always sets `minRamGB: 2, maxRamGB: 4` (line 339) first; `if flavor.category == .modded { cfgServer.minRamGB = 3; cfgServer.maxRamGB = 6 }` (line 345-348) then overrides it for any modded flavor -- Fabric, NeoForge, and Forge all get 3/6 GB, every standard-category flavor keeps 2/4 GB.
